ITEM 1 | Crumbled/flaked white mass, opaque off-white to pale cream with slight yellowish tint in spots, soft and crumbly with irregular rough edges and small curds, moist-looking but not flowing, piled in a mound covering the upper-left/center of the plate, roughly 12 cm across and 2-3 cm high, sitting directly on the plate | 170

ITEM 2 | Cubed orange-red pieces with browned/caramelized edges and slightly glossy, moist surface, cut into irregular chunks about 1.5-3 cm, some with darker charred-looking spots, mixed with a few darker brown cubes, clustered in the lower-left and lower-right of the plate and partially touching the white mound, covering roughly 35% of the plate | 190

ITEM 3 | Thin orange-yellow smear and small droplets of oily liquid pooled along the right side of the white mound and plate, glossy, low volume, spread into a thin film around the food | 5
